Jasper's dinner account still shows 38.40 pounds owing for last half term. You mentioned you may ask about help with costs if your hours at the garage are cut in the new year.

If anything changes, please ring Eirlys Beynon in the kitchen on 01632 960417.

Kind regards,
Rhiannon Pugh
